candidate score is only a pre-filter: _arbitrate_state_candidates reads score and drops candidates below the per-block top score before resolve(); survivors are still ranked by resolver._candidate_strength on positive_evidence.kind (T04)
list_render_level_clamped is exposed through module evidence rather than blocking publication; real multi-level rendering belongs to T08

implicit list runs have no tail continuation: ITEM_CONTINUATION and ITEM_CHILD_BLOCK are only emitted inside explicit list_item containers, so an implicit DOCX [item][body][item] is materialized as two lists (README constraint 5 gap, T05)

README constraints 3 and 4 are validated only for implicit runs; _implicit_list_runs_for_parent returns [] for list/list_item parents, so explicit list containers are never constraint-checked (T04/T05)

the genuine-tie ambiguity path is only reachable from synthetic evidence: both adapters write marker_kind only with numbering_status=detected, so state_unresolved stays empty for real input and README constraint 7's literal threshold semantics are not implemented (T04/T05)
